meta.name: Pokémon Horizons
meta.description: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

videos.title: The Pendant That Starts It All (1)
videos.overview: Liko arrives at Indigo Academy and meets her partner Pokémon, Sprigatito.

videos.title: The Pendant That Starts It All (2)
videos.overview: Friede, Captain Pikachu and the Rising Volt Tacklers step up to help protect Liko.

videos.title: For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!
videos.overview: Liko, Friede and the other Rising Volt Tacklers set out to rescue Sprigatito.

videos.title: The Treasure After the Storm!
videos.overview: As Liko settles in on the Brave Olivine, the Fuecoco who lives on the ship goes missing!

videos.title: Found You, Fuecoco!
videos.overview: After Roy sneaks onto the Brave Olivine, he and Fuecoco get their chance to shine!

videos.title: The Ancient Poké Ball!
videos.overview: A Rayquaza suddenly emerges from Roy’s Ancient Poké Ball, leaving everyone with questions!

videos.title: Special Training with Cap!
videos.overview: Liko and Roy learn a thing or two about Pokémon battles from Friede and Captain Pikachu!

videos.title: The Door That Never Opens
videos.overview: While the rest of the crew goes shopping, Liko ramps up her efforts to befriend Dot.

videos.title: Welcome to Paldea!
videos.overview: Back in Paldea, the time has come for Liko to part ways with the Rising Volt Tacklers.

videos.title: Nemona and Brassius and...
videos.overview: Liko and Roy arrive in Artazon, but gym leader Brassius is in an artistic slump!

videos.title: Arboliva's Forest
videos.overview: Searching for Arboliva, Liko, Roy and Mollie discover a forest devastated by wildfire.

videos.title: The Future I Choose
videos.overview: After learning the story of the Ancient Adventurer, Liko is faced with a decision.

videos.title: An Unexpected Picnic!
videos.overview: While the Brave Olivine has its computer system rebooted, it’s picnic time for the crew!

videos.title: Fly! Wattrel!!
videos.overview: As Friede tracks suspicious activity, Roy comes up with some special training for Wattrel.

videos.title: Someone We Can't See! Whosawhatsit?!
videos.overview: Liko has gone missing, so Dot calls on a celebrity connection for help!

videos.title: Quaxly, We Can Do It
videos.overview: Officially a trainer, Dot teams up with Quaxly to help take back Liko’s stolen pendant!

videos.title: Special Training Time!
videos.overview: Fuecoco and Wattrel aren't getting along, so Roy sets up some teamwork training!

videos.title: Flying Pikachu, Rising Higher and Higher!
videos.overview: Friede tells the Rising Volt Tacklers the story of how he and Captain Pikachu first met.

videos.title: The Bittersweet Truth
videos.overview: A stop at the Battle Café in Motostoke brings back painful memories for Murdock.

videos.title: Kabu's Battle Training!
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and their Pokémon receive some red-hot training from Gym Leader Kabu!

videos.title: The Lonely Hatenna
videos.overview: After rescuing a wild Hatenna, Liko contemplates her own feelings and makes a new friend!

videos.title: Charge! Galar Mine!
videos.overview: Inside Galar Mine, Liko and the others find a Pokémon that doesn't seem happy to see them!

videos.title: Fiery Galarian Moltres
videos.overview: Faced with an enraged Galarian Moltres, Liko comes up with a different kind of strategy.

videos.title: Reunion at the Ancient Castle!
videos.overview: Finally meeting up with her grandma, Liko learns the identity of the pendant Pokémon.

videos.title: Rivals in the Dark of Night!
videos.overview: Working separately, Amethio and Hamber set out to steal Terapagos from Liko.

videos.title: Terapagos's Adventure!
videos.overview: A curious Liko tries to keep up with Terapagos as it explores the Brave Olivine.

videos.title: As Long As I'm with My Friends
videos.overview: A visit to the Wild Area turns into a curry-making adventure for the Rising Volt Tacklers!

videos.title: The Stolen Treasure
videos.overview: When Roy's Ancient Poké Ball is stolen, the Rising Volt Tacklers track down the thief!

videos.title: Orla and the Poké Ball Smith
videos.overview: When a Poké Ball factory goes on the fritz, Orla steps up to the challenge of fixing it!

videos.title: Slip and Crash! A Mystery Pokémon?!
videos.overview: Strange things are happening aboard the Brave Olivine - could a Pokémon be the cause?

videos.title: Song Within the Mist
videos.overview: Searching for Lapras, the Rising Volt Tacklers investigate an odd white mist over the sea.

videos.title: Lapras's Feelings for Its Friends
videos.overview: Liko comes up with a plan for confronting Lapras of the Six Heroes.

videos.title: Roar of the Black Rayquaza
videos.overview: Amethio challenges the black Rayquaza, and Terapagos displays some of its true power.

videos.title: Respective Departures
videos.overview: As Diana prepares to leave the Brave Olivine, Amethio battles Hamber to become stronger.

videos.title: The Wild Pair, Friede and Cap!
videos.overview: Friede and Captain Pikachu team up to rescue a lost Bramblin from Pokémon hunters.

videos.title: Mission: Find Oinkologne's Partner!
videos.overview: Nidothing, Liko and Roy help a female Oinkologne win the attention of a popular male.

videos.title: Fuecoco... Becomes a Crook?!
videos.overview: Fuecoco does its best to quell a group of angry wild Pokémon with song and dance!

videos.title: The SOS Is from Tandemaus?
videos.overview: Liko, Mollie and their Pokémon set out to save a Tandemaus pair separated by a storm.

videos.title: Tinkatink's Ideal Hammer
videos.overview: Dot befriends a Tinkatink that is determined to make just the right hammer!

videos.title: Farewell, Sprigatito?
videos.overview: Liko's partnership is put to the test after an accident causes Sprigatito to return home.

videos.title: A Wild Mom Appears!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers are visited by Dot's mum, and she's here to take Dot home!

videos.title: Transform! Hero of the Seas, Palafin
videos.overview: During a day at the beach, Liko and Roy meet a Pokémon with a superhero secret!

videos.title: A Challenge from the Explorers
videos.overview: While shopping in a seaside town, Liko and Roy receive a strange invitation to battle!

videos.title: The Plan to Capture Rayquaza (1)
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers uncover a plot by the Explorers to capture the black Rayquaza.

videos.title: From So Far Away (2)
videos.overview: A battle against the black Rayquaza makes Liko realise all she has accomplished so far!

videos.title: Welcome to Naranja Academy!
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot begin their first day of Tera training in the Paldea Region!

videos.title: Put Your Heart into It!
videos.overview: Liko and Floragato try out Terastallisation in a battle against Cortondo Gym leader Katy.

videos.title: Sparkle! The Glow of Flame and Art
videos.overview: Roy's first Tera training test pits him against a familiar face - gym leader Brassius!

videos.title: Dot and Nidothing
videos.overview: Dot struggles to accept Iono’s plan to livestream their upcoming Tera training battle.

videos.title: Trending Terastallisation! Dance, Dance, Quaxly!
videos.overview: Dot creates a plan for her Tera training aptitude test against Iono - but will it work?

videos.title: The Flower Tower
videos.overview: Liko keeps getting distracted by Hatenna and Terapagos, and Floragato isn't happy!

videos.title: Wattrel's High Wind Warning!
videos.overview: When Roy needs help, Wattrel gets a chance to show its trainer just how much it has grown!

videos.title: Hatenna and the Otherworldly
videos.overview: Liko, Roy, and Dot search for an eerie Pokémon known as the Otherworldly.

videos.title: The Treasure of Eternity
videos.overview: Friede visits his former workplace to look for clues about the mystery behind Terapagos.

videos.title: Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four (1)
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot are back at Naranja Academy in time to battle the Elite Four!

videos.title: Liko vs. Rika! Toward the Battle's End (2)
videos.overview: During a match against Rika of the Elite Four, Liko realises what battling is all about.

videos.title: The Terapagos I Don't Know
videos.overview: A visit to Naranja Academy results in answers, and new questions, about Terapagos.

videos.title: Food Fit for a Kingambit!
videos.overview: Dot shines when dysfunction is on the menu for Kingambit and a struggling café!

videos.title: Dance, Quaxly! The Blue Medali Step!
videos.overview: Dot, Quaxly and Tinkatink face gym leader Larry in their latest Tera training test.

videos.title: Roy and Fuecoco's First Snow!
videos.overview: On the way to Montenevera, Liko, Roy and Dot make a pit stop on snowy Glaseado Mountain.

videos.title: Resonating Spirits in a Challenge to Ryme!
videos.overview: Roy and Fuecoco make singing their strategy in a Tera Training usage test against Ryme.

videos.title: A New Song for Fuecoco
videos.overview: In a rematch against Ryme, Roy and Fuecoco take the power of their song to the next level.

videos.title: Ice Battle! Cold-Eyed Grusha
videos.overview: Liko and her Pokémon face gym leader Grusha in battle on top of snowy Glaseado Mountain.

videos.title: The Approaching Shadow!
videos.overview: The explorers cause Liko to become separated from Roy and Dot on Glaseado Mountain.

videos.title: Liko and Amethio
videos.overview: Liko and Amethio are trapped in a freezing cave and must work together to escape.

videos.title: Infiltrating the System! Naranja Academy in Danger!
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot jump into action when the Explorers stage an attack on Naranja Academy.

videos.title: Shine On, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!
videos.overview: As Tera training comes to an end, Liko and Roy face off in battle at Naranja Academy.

videos.title: Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!
videos.overview: Back on the Brave Olivine, Liko, Roy and Dot receive an unexpected challenge to battle.

videos.title: Roy Is Crocalor, and Crocalor Is Roy!
videos.overview: Roy and Crocalor accidentally switch places while exploring a festival in Kitakami.

videos.title: Tinkatink's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Day
videos.overview: Tinkatink puts up a fight when a wild Bombirdier tries to mess with its beloved hammer.

videos.title: Encounters at the Crystal Pool
videos.overview: Encounters at the Crystal Pool lead to battles, new friends and discoveries about the past.

videos.title: The Search for Kleavor!
videos.overview: Joined by Perrin, the Rising Volt Tacklers set out to find Kleavor on Tengu Mountain.

videos.title: Kleavor the Solitary Warrior
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot finally find Kleavor of the Six Heroes and it wants to battle!

videos.title: The Three Explorers
videos.overview: Diana returns and tells the Rising Volt Tacklers about the true origin of the Explorers.

videos.title: The Wonders of the World!
videos.overview: At the Crystal Pool, Rystal recalls when she, Lucius and Gibeon reached Laqua.

videos.title: Wynaut? Wy-Yes!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers meet up with a former member who might know Entei's whereabouts.

videos.title: Ludlow's Homecoming!
videos.overview: A trip to Olivine City gives Ludlow a chance to reminisce about his home town.

videos.title: Entei's Fierce Battle Cry!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers work together to battle Entei after finally tracking it down.

videos.title: Over the Top!
videos.overview: Chairwoman Geeta challenges Liko, Roy and Dot to a battle to test their strength.

videos.title: Total-lie Awesome Pokémon in Area Zero?!
videos.overview: A descent into the Great Crater of Paldea reveals wonders and Pokémon beyond imagination.

videos.title: The Pillar of Fire
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers locate Entei of the Six Heroes, but something seems off.

videos.title: Beyond the Shining Rainbow
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers finally get a rematch with the Black Rayquaza!

videos.title: The Truth Revealed!
videos.overview: Amethio searches for answers about his grandfather's history and goals.

videos.title: Where the Land Meets the Sky
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers visit a mountain town on the way to Laqua.

videos.title: The Pokémon Paradise of Laqua!
videos.overview: Following a long journey, the Rising Volt Tacklers finally reach Laqua!

videos.title: The Rising Volt Tacklers vs. the Explorers!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers and the Explorers battle over the fate of Laqua.

videos.title: Guided by the Black Rayquaza!
videos.overview: After 100 years, the secrets of Laqua finally come to light.

videos.title: The Earthshaking White Zygarde
videos.overview: Liko and friends show their strength in a battle against Gibeon and the White Zygarde.

videos.title: Where the Adventure Leads
videos.overview: Terapagos uses its power to purify Laqua, but a new threat waits in the shadows.

videos.title: Eyes to the Skies Once Again (1)
videos.overview: Life is back to normal for Roy and friends, until wild Pokémon begin to act strangely...

videos.title: Eyes to the Skies Once Again (2)
videos.overview: After a year apart, Roy visits Liko at Indigo Academy to ask for her help.

videos.title: Following Traces of Laquium
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot investigate a report of Pokémon affected by Laquium.

videos.title: Clash of the Nidothing Fans!
videos.overview: Liko and Meowscarada face off against a fellow Nidothing fan who really loves Litten.

videos.title: The Pokémon Center Lady
videos.overview: Liko and Roy reunite with one of their friends from the Rising Volt Tacklers.

videos.title: The Strong Sphere
videos.overview: Trainers put an intriguing new device into action at an Exceed testing centre.

videos.title: Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!
videos.overview: An encounter with a gang of Dragon Tamers leads Liko and Roy to an unexpected reunion.

videos.title: The Prankster
videos.overview: With Iono's help, Dot confronts a trainer who has been playing pranks with his Stunfisk.

videos.title: Reunion in Cortondo
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Ult reunite with Dot and Murdock in Cortondo.

videos.title: Orla, Grounded
videos.overview: Memories come flooding back when Orla is asked to build a new airship.

videos.title: We Are the Rising Volt Tacklers!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers reunite and prepare to take to the skies once more.

videos.title: Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!
videos.overview: Now reunited, the Rising Volt Tacklers head to Naranja Academy, where they present their findings, run into old friends and face off in a super showdown!

videos.title: The Knight in the Ruins
videos.overview: Searching for traces of Laquium, Liko and Pagogo encounter a familiar Pokémon.

videos.title: Nidothing Love!
videos.overview: Liko, Roy and Dot team up with Zirc and Onia on an unusual mission!

videos.title: Charcadet's Wish!
videos.overview: Liko, Zirc and Onia find Amethio living on a deserted island.

videos.title: Riding the Waves
videos.overview: Amethio meets Mighty G, and a surfing Gholdengo wows the Rising Volt Tacklers.

videos.title: The Dusk Ball That Wouldn't Open
videos.overview: Ult leaves the Brave Olivine after an argument with Roy.

videos.title: Friends as Two, Me and You
videos.overview: Roy and Ult must work together when they get caught in the Explorers' trap.

videos.title: Taking the Next Steps
videos.overview: Diana arrives with new info about Terapagos and the Six Heroes.

videos.title: Tinkatuff's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Year!
videos.overview: Tinkatuff goes on a quest to find the perfect metal for completing its hammer.

videos.title: The Six Heroes Unleashed!
videos.overview: The Explorers lure in the Rising Volt Tacklers for a battle against former friends.

videos.title: Better, Farther, Stronger!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers struggle to keep up against the rampaging Six Heroes.

videos.title: Mega Evolution - Roy
videos.overview: Roy recounts his first meetings with Lucario and Ult in Lumiose City.

videos.title: Mega Evolution - Ult
videos.overview: A tough loss causes Ult to consider what it means to be a Pokémon Trainer.

videos.title: Mega Evolution - Bonds
videos.overview: Roy and Ult return to the Lost Mayo Maze for a rematch with Lucario.

videos.title: Welcome to Blueberry Academy!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers meet up with new and old friends at Blueberry Academy.

videos.title: Terarium Training!
videos.overview: Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult begin their training inside the Terarium.

videos.title: Ult-imate Training
videos.overview: Lacey challenges Ult with a special kind of training in the Terarium.

videos.title: Liko and Hattrem, Bonded by Happiness!
videos.overview: Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

videos.title: Don't Give Up, Crocalor!
videos.overview: Roy, Crocalor and Kilowattrel take on Drayton in a spirited rematch.

videos.title: Dot and Penny's Top-Secret Mission!
videos.overview: Dot and Penny infiltrate Exceed's server room, but obstacles await.

videos.title: The Catcher in the Sky
videos.overview: As Friede returns from space, his re-entry capsule malfunctions.

videos.title: Roy vs. Friede: Wings of Fire!
videos.overview: Roy and Friede battle to determine the fate of the Rising Volt Tacklers.

videos.title: Mochi Mayhem!
videos.overview: A mysterious force causes the Rising Volt Tacklers to begin dancing mindlessly.

videos.title: Operation Infiltration!
videos.overview: Amethio joins Liko and friends to break into the Explorers' headquarters.

videos.title: Battle for the Six Heroes!
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers get split up and must battle the Six Heroes one-on-one.

videos.title: Strong Bonds, Can't Lose!
videos.overview: Liko and friends try to stop the use of the Strong Sphere at Naranja Academy.

videos.title: The Training Royale!
videos.overview: Liko and friends train together at the Pokémon League's battle room in Paldea.

videos.title: Dot and Quaxwell Step It Up!
videos.overview: A battle with Iono might be just what Dot needs to regain her confidence.

videos.title: Destiny of the Black Rayquaza
videos.overview: Roy and Ult face off against the black Rayquaza in a fateful battle.

videos.title: Hamber's Moonlight Battle
videos.overview: As Liko and friends seek the 18 Tera Types, Hamber faces off against the Explorers.

videos.title: A Surprise Reunion
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers are surprised by the arrival of some unexpected guests.

videos.title: Lucario's Challenge!
videos.overview: Roy and Lucario take on Master Mayonnaise and Mega Hawlucha in a rematch battle.

videos.title: The Final Battle Is Near
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers set out for Laqua, where the Explorers are waiting.

videos.title: One Step Closer
videos.overview: The final showdown begins between the Rising Volt Tacklers and the Explorers.

videos.title: The Core Awakens
videos.overview: Liko and friends must find a way to fight the increasingly strong Laquium Core.

videos.title: Stellar Finale
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers face Spinel and the Laquium Core in a final battle.

videos.title: Reboot! Off to the World of Adventure!!
videos.overview: Now that their adventure in Rakua is over, Liko and the others have just been sitting around absentmindedly without doing much of anything. However, one day Friede visits them and invites them along for some fieldwork to investigate an amazing Pokémon. That Pokémon turns out to be a Hinbass...

videos.title: Enter the Fake Rising Volteccers!?
videos.overview: News of the Rising Volt Tacklers helping people has become the talk of the town all over... however, Liko and the others have absolutely no idea what these stories are referring to. Could there be impostors around...? The group head off to investigate in order to find out what's going on... and believe it or not, while they're asking around for information, they discover a second Brave Asagi?! Just who are the Fake Rising Volt Tacklers...?

videos.title: The Secret Metamon Rhapsody
videos.overview: Laudbon and the others are starving, but as they search for berries, a Metamon who's tried to Transform into Cap appears before them. The naive and childlike Metamon quickly befriends the Pokémon from the airship, however...

videos.title: Clap Clap Clap! Mini Gurumin!!
videos.overview: Metamon crashes one of Gurumin's livestreams after having tried to Transform into her. Dot gets upset about this and wants to pretend it never happened, but the "Mini-Gurumin" incident actually becomes quite the talk of of town in her fandom... so Dot decides to take Metamon along for the bread festival she's been invited to hold a show at...

videos.title: READY GO! Unite Battle!!
videos.overview: Liko and the others land on Aeos Island! There, Liko, Roy, Dot, Uruto and Friede will try their hands at a Unite Battle!

videos.title: Miare City! New Encounters
videos.overview: Liko and the others have arrived in Miare City,and go visit the Handsome House, where they meet Matiere and her assistant Navi. Navi really loves Pokémon,and takes a great interest in Liko and the others. Just then, Matiere receives a request to locate a Melecie. And when the group starts investigating, they learn that a large blonde man wearing a dougi was accompanying it.

videos.title: A Dream Ball for You!
videos.overview: Navi is really depressed due to losing the Dream Ball. It was really dear to her, as she had been given it by Matiere so that she'd one day use it to catch hold of her dream... Meanwhile, Metamon picks up the Dream Ball Navi dropped on the airship and decides to head off to Miare City all by itself in order to return it to her...! Will Metamon be able to find Navi and return the Dream Ball safe and sound?!

videos.title: Navi's Little Big Adventure!
videos.overview: Navi has got Metamon and become a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers! The upfront and enthusiastic Navi immediately hits it off with the rest of the crew, but just doesn't seem to click with Uruto... Liko suggests the two of them run an errand in the nearby town, but as expected, they end up fighting again! But when Navi goes off on her own, she ends up getting lost?!

videos.title: Shocking! Mega Rayquaza and the Mysterious Land!?
videos.overview: The mystical land of Area Delta is said to have a terrifying Pokémon that abducts trespassers into another world... and it's a Mega Rayquaza?! Pokémon journalist Sohdayo invites Liko and the others along to ascertain the truth... however, they're faced with one mysterious, unnatural phenomenon after another...?!

videos.title: Wanival and Dekanuchan's Great Sleep Operation!
videos.overview: Just as Wanival and Dekanuchan are suffering from sleep deprivation, Liko and the others run into Professor Neroli, a researcher of Pokémon sleeping. They all travel together to Wakakusa Island to try using the power of the Kabigon there to put Wanival and Dekanuchan to sleep, but the hungry Kabigon ends up waking up... and the group starts working on trying to make Comatose Butter Curry in order to fill it up and make it go back to sleep!!

videos.title: Crazy Feels! This Is a Pokémon Contest, Dearie!!
videos.overview: Liko decides to enter a Pokémon Contest with Masquernya, Laudbon and Wanival! And after getting trained by the self-styled "coach" Navi, it's finally time for the real deal! The venue is filled with skilled performers, last but not least the Pikachu idol group "Cutie Pikapika", and Liko starts feeling quite uneasy as she watches them perform...

videos.title: Koraidon & Miraidon! The Great Paldea Race!!
videos.overview: One day Liko and the others go watch a Mototokage race, where Liko ends up encountering a Miraidon and Roy ends up encountering a Koraidon. The two mistake these Pokémon for Mototokage and befriend them by feeding them, but when Koraidon and Miraidon hear the sounds of the race, they break into a dash... and Liko and Roy somehow end up entering the race as a result.

videos.title: A Squishy Pokémon! If You Squish It and It Squishes, It's Squishy Time
videos.overview: Liko and Navi visit a cafe to try a Metamon collab menu they're offering. There they encounter Yakata, an office worker with a Namakobushi and a Yukihami on his shoulders and a Bachinuni on his head. Yakata explains how he loves squishiness more than anything, and invites Liko and the others to to try "SquishyPoké Activities", or "SquiPoActs" for short; Activities all about loving and cherishing squishy Pokémon.

videos.title: The Expanding World, GO with You!
videos.overview: Liko and the others get invited to join Friede on some fieldwork of his, where they're also accompanied by Professor Willow, a professor traveling the world to research Pokémon! As they conduct their research, Liko and the others ask Friede how he and Lizardon first met. It turns out that this happened while Friede was still a kid and Lizardon was a Hitokage... and it's now time to reveal that story.

videos.title: Navi and the Mysterious Masked Child
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers visit a festival in the Land of Kitakami, where Liko and the others meet Seille again. Meanwhile Navi, who's never been to a Kitakami festival before and is in really high spirits, meets a mysterious kid wearing a mask. They play together and become friends, but...

videos.title: The Revered Companions Attack! Momowarou's Decision!!
videos.overview: As Liko and the others wonder what Pokémon it was that defiled the offerings, Diana and Momowarou arrive in the Land of Kitakami as well, and they all decide to walk around the festival together. There, Momowarou encounters Iineinu, Mashimashira and Kichikigisu, the Pokémon referred to as the Little Companions. And it seems they were actually Momowarou's former companions...?!

videos.title: Paldea in Ruin: Resurrection (1)
videos.overview: Navi meets the Star Gang, while Raifort asks Liko and the others to investigate the strange phenomena occurring in the Paldea region.

videos.title: Paldea in Ruin: Charge (2)
videos.overview: The Ruinous Pokémon were completely beyond Liko and the others' capabilities. Raifort tells them that according to legend, these four were apparently born from "curses placed upon treasures"... But why are the Ruinous Pokémon on a rampage? In addition, the group learns that the quartet is heading for Table City, the location of Orange Academy. Orange Academy and the campus festival are in danger!!

videos.title: Paldea in Ruin: Reunion (3)
videos.overview: Protect Orange Academy and everyone's campus festival! The Ruinous Pokémon head towards Table City from the four corners of Paldea. If the four were to gather, a catastrophe would unavoidable... Liko and the other split into four groups and do their upmost to stop the Ruinous Pokémon, but find themselves getting more and more driven against the wall by their overwhelming power. And then, the four ultimately meet up...?!

videos.title: Syaritatsu, Order Up!
videos.overview: Liko and the others take the Syaritatsu with them to Lake Zugogo, where they meet a group of Heyrusher! The Syaritatsu are curious about the Heyrusher, however... it looks like the Heyrusher are scared of something? It turns out they're actually being bullied by cruel Migalusa that live in the lake... But when the Syaritatsu learn this, they suddenly jump into the Heyrusher's mouths...?!

videos.title: Making a Magnificent Entrance! Dandy H!!
videos.overview: One night, a parent and child get surrounded by a group of Shizariger. But just as the Shizariger are about to attack, rescue arrives in the form of... the legendary hero Mighty G! ...or actually, in the form of the heroic gentleman Dandy H?! But who in the world is he?! Dandy H then challenges Mighty G to a duel in... believe it or not, curry cooking...?!

videos.title: A Heart Burning with Passion Spreads Like Wildfire
videos.overview: After learning there's been eyewitness accounts of weak and frail Pokémon nearby, Molly goes looking for them and discovers a group of Donmel that are cold and in poor shape. They need heat...! Just then, the Magmag and Toroggon that are normally always in the engine room approach her?! Orio joins them soon after, having been searching for the duo. Will this group be able to save the Donmel?!

videos.title: Uruto and Yamirami! A Bond More Solid Than Stone!!
videos.overview: The "Soleilstone" is a rock said to contain the power of eternal earth. Uruto really wants it for his rock collection, so he decides to go search for it alongside Dot, who's after a topic that can go viral online! Thanks to the stone searching expert Yamirami, the two are able to locate the cave where the stone can be found, but they're unable to find the actual stone there. Not only that, but a furious Crimgan shows up as well, forcing them to battle it! And then the Crimgan's fierce attacks end up causing a cave-in...?!

videos.title: Yumeko and Roy's Song
videos.overview: The Rising Volt Tacklers visit a town where the blizzards are so powerful the locals refer to them as "White Darkness". Here, Roy ends up losing his way after getting separated from Liko and the others, though he manages to seek shelter in a cave where he meets Yumeko, a girl who lives together with a group of Ghost Pokémon. Yumeko tells Roy that since she lives so far from civilization, she'd really like to have a human friend... and the two of them eventually start to connect emotionally through song. However...

videos.title: Dreaming Metamon Paradise
videos.overview: Navi and Metamon wake up on a desert island with nobody else around. They decide to go search for their companions from the Rising Volt Tacklers, and end up having a massive adventure where Metamon gets to Transform into the various Pokémon they've met on their journey so far; Captain Pikachu, Masquernya, and even Ratta! And what awaits as the end of this adventure is... a certain Legendary Pokémon?!

videos.title: Navi Is a Rising Volteccer!
videos.overview: There's an outbreak of Dokukurage in a bay?! The Rising Volt Tacklers are called in to help, and when they arrive on the island, they all make use of their particular field of expertise to help the Pokémon there. Seeing her companions hard at work like this also inspires Navi to do her best as a fellow Rising Volt Tackler! Eventually, the group puts a plan to remove the Dokukurage from the bay into motion. And this plan relies on... Navi and Metamon!!
